n, m, Mod = map(int, input().split())

MAXN = 577
C = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
res = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
res2 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
dp = [0] * MAXN
dp2 = [0] * MAXN

for i in range(MAXN):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1

for i in range(1, MAXN):
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[j][i] = (C[j][i - 1] + C[j - 1][i - 1]) % Mod

def sumRange(left, right):
    return ((left + right) * (right - left + 1) // 2) % Mod

dp[0] = 1
dp2[0] = 0

for length in range(1, n + 1):
    for i in range(1, length + 1):
        total = sumRange(1, i - 1) + sumRange(1, length - i)
        count = length + 1
        temp1 = (dp[i - 1] * count % Mod) * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        temp2 = total * dp[i - 1] % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        temp3 = dp2[i - 1] * count % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        temp4 = dp2[length - i] * count % Mod * dp[i - 1] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        dp[length] = (dp[length] + temp1) % Mod
        dp2[length] = (dp2[length] + temp2 + temp3 + temp4) % Mod

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        res[i][j] = res[i - 1][j]
        res2[i][j] = res2[i - 1][j]
        for h in range(1, j):
            res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res2[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp2[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
        res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + dp[j]) % Mod
        res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + dp2[j]) % Mod

print(res2[n][m])
</translated_code>
